name: Angola
summary: Southwestern African nation with Atlantic coastline and expansive central plateau. Exploits offshore crude oil while expanding Kwanza River hydroelectric dams to decarbonize the national grid.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 5.56x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); agricultural clearing and unpaved road dust elevate dry season aerosol optical depth.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; seasonal drought variability across southern Cunene and Namibe provinces.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Linear warming rate across central plateau stations over 1994-2023.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 0.07% share of global fossil emissions; major crude oil producer with low domestic refining throughput.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: Low per capita footprint; large portions of rural population rely on off-grid biomass.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Extensive Miombo woodlands and Cabinda rainforests covering ~666,000 km².

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Laúca and Cambambe hydroelectric complexes on the Kwanza River supply dominant grid power.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Arithmetic population density of 29 people/km²; urban population fraction is 68.1%.
